text:
The primary material of a candle is wax.

Drawing from the cultural elements of the Maasai people, an artistic concept titled "The Beacon of Valor" can be envisioned. This piece would feature a candle crafted from deep red beeswax, honoring the iconic 'Shúkà' cloth and its symbolism of strength and valor. The candle’s surface would be adorned with intricate, raised patterns mimicking the bold geometric designs of traditional Maasai attire. Surrounding the base, a ring of hand-beaded glass tubes, arranged in the style of the 'Engari', would serve as a decorative holder. These beads would be color-coded to represent specific cultural narratives—such as age, social status, and marital status—transforming the functional object into a storytelling artifact that honors the rich heritage and communicative power of Maasai beadwork.
